title: DigiTransition – Acelerar a Transição Digital das PMEs e das Entidades Públicas
excerpt: DigiTransition ‘s main objective is to accelerate the digital transition of companies connected to the built environment and public entities.
content:
DigiTransition ‘s main objective is to accelerate the digital transition of companies connected to the built environment and public entities.

The main objective of DigiTrransition is to accelerate the digital transition of companies linked to the built environment, which is strongly marked by SMEs, as well as public entities. This acceleration will be promoted by the implementation of a Digital Transition Plan, at national level, whose action plan will include everything from observing the level of digital maturity to defining implementation strategies in a national and international context.

The evolutionary record of business digitalization will be reported through an online platform from which it will be possible to map the real needs of the AEC sector and, consequently, adjust the operation of the Digital Transition Plan.

The Future of Construction project has developed a Strategic Plan for the Digital Transformation of the AEC Sector, which underpins this project and allows the digital transition process for SMEs to be adapted to each case. It should be noted that a Digital Maturity Survey has been implemented which allows the sector to be diagnosed in terms of SMEs.

Main Activities

  • Support for the definition of a nationwide digital transition plan
